messages:
Dana Lin: Thanks everyone — quick follow-up from today's all-hands with answers + owners. Posting links and a short action checklist below. Please react with :white_check_mark: when you've taken your action.

Priya Patel: timeline Q — when is Dedicated GA expected? we got asked by a pilot customer.

Dana Lin: Targeting GA in mid-May (internal milestone M-2026-05-15). We'll publish the public GA page when SLA wording is finalized. Ben and Miguel to own final stability tests.

Ben Ortiz: I'm happy to take stability tests. Miguel can you pair on the long-tail perf runs? I'll open a tracker.

Miguel Santos: Yep — I'll schedule the 72h perf run across B1/B2 instances. I'll add run configs to the shared gist.

Sam Park: For canary rollouts — are we keeping the old model fallback or using model variants routing? need to know for integration tests.

Dana Lin: We'll use routing -> variant fallback by default; canary will route 10% to new variant with auto-fallback to stable on error. Docs + example policy here: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/canary-routing (internal).

Rachel Yu: Private/on-prem packaging question: will the initial Private release include the VPC control plane only or full on-prem bundle? customers ask about air-gapped support.

Dana Lin: Private first release will be VPC control plane + edge deployer. Full air-gapped on-prem bundle is v1.1 (post-GA). Rachel, can you coordinate with Security for KMS/HSM checklist?

Rachel Yu: On it — will sync with Security and post the checklist in #eng-security by EOW.

Priya Patel: One more: any updates on the Optimize recommendations UI? PM asked if we can surface batch suggestions per-route.

Ben Ortiz: We're prototyping a per-route suggestion panel in the Console. Miguel and I will hook the telemetry sample to the UI stub. ETA: 2 sprints.

Dana Lin: Thanks — below is the action list I promised. I've assigned tentative owners; if a different owner makes more sense reply here.

```
Action items (short):
- Dedicated GA stability runs: owner=Ben Ortiz + Miguel Santos, due=2026-04-30, ticket=#4873
- Publish GA page & SLA copy: owner=Priya Patel, due=2026-05-05, doc=https://redwood.company/ga-landing-draft
- Canary routing docs + example policy: owner=Sam Park, due=2026-04-18, runbook=https://redwood.internal/runbooks/canary-routing
- Private packaging KMS checklist: owner=Rachel Yu, due=2026-04-22, thread=#eng-security
- Per-route Optimize UI prototype: owner=Ben Ortiz, due=2026-05-07, prototype link=https://figma.com/redwood/optimize-per-route
- Eval rollouts + regression checks: owner=Priya Patel + Research, due=2026-04-28, tracker=#evals-ops
```

Miguel Santos: I'll post the perf run schedule and the gist with run config tomorrow morning.

Priya Patel: I'll take GA page draft and loop Legal for SLA language. posting draft in 48h.

Sam Park: I'll add the canary policy example to the runbooks and throw an integration smoke test into CI.

Dana Lin: Recording and timestamped notes: https://meetings.redwood/ah-2026-03-22-recording (jump to 00:42:15 for roadmap Q&A).

ops-bot: Meeting recording uploaded by Dana Lin: https://meetings.redwood/ah-2026-03-22-recording

Ben Ortiz: quick ask — can we get token-level SLOs added to the GA checklist? helps with customer SLAs.

Dana Lin: Good call. Adding token-level SLO item to GA checklist (Ben added as owner).

Rachel Yu: Tagging Security folks: @Nina, @Omar — can you give an initial read on the KMS/HSM checklist once I post?

Sam Park: small follow-up for eng infra — do we have a preferred quantization baseline for Dedicated? would like to avoid last-minute model swaps.

Miguel Santos: baseline suggestion: int8-quant + fp16 fallback. I'll put numbers from the perf runs in the run results doc.

Priya Patel: I'll compile all open asks into a single tracker and share a weekly digest.

Dana Lin: Thanks team. Please update the checklist items above with :white_check_mark: when done. We'll review progress in next week's leadership sync.

Ben Ortiz: ack :white_check_mark: (I'll update ticket #4873 when the first run finishes)

Miguel Santos: ack — posting run schedule at 09:00 PT tomorrow.

Rachel Yu: ack — will post KMS checklist draft by EOD Thursday.

Sam Park: ack — adding canary smoke test to CI pipeline today.

Priya Patel: ack — GA page draft will be in the doc by Sun.

Dana Lin: closing loop — if anything else comes up, reply here or DM. Thanks for the quick turnaround! :tada:
